item.title: Awakening the “Divine Feminine” Is Not Biblical
item.description: The message to awaken your inner goddess is spreading rapidly across social media and New Age spirituality, yet it stands in direct opposition to biblical Christianity. This episode of New Age to Christ exposes the deception behind the so called divine feminine movement and points listeners back to worship of God alone.

item.title: Esther’s Bold Approach and God’s Unseen Providence
item.description: In Esther 5, Queen Esther steps forward in courageous faith, trusting God’s unseen providence and sovereign timing. This episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave explores courage, wisdom, pride, and how Esther’s intercession points us to Christ.

item.title: Esther 6, The Turning Point, God’s Providence Revealed
item.description: Esther 6 reveals the turning point of God’s providence as the proud are humbled and the faithful honored. A Christ-centered study of divine reversal.

item.title: The Moral Collapse of the Modern Church, Standing Firm in God’s Design
item.description: In this Weekly Watch episode of Contending for the Word, Dave Jenkins examines the growing confusion over sexual ethics within evangelical churches, the erosion of biblical authority, and how Christians must stand firm in God’s good design with clarity, conviction, and compassion.
